title: Google TPU v4 張量超級電腦
summary: 以矩陣陣列與可重組三維互連解析Google TPU v4 張量超級電腦：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Google TPU v4 tensor supercomputer through matrix arrays and reconfigurable 3d interconnects: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 原創張量、運算成本及失效分析。架構圖是功能教學示意，非晶片floorplan或專有電路；數字為假想，需依精度、shape、資料分佈與系統邊界重算。
scopeEn: Original tensor, compute-cost and failure analysis. Functional diagrams are not chip floorplans/proprietary circuits; assumed values need recalculation for precision, shape, data and boundaries.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Google TPU v4 張量超級電腦案例中比較v4 MXU張量shape與vector/scalar單元，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate v4 mxu tensor shapes and vector/scalar units within the Google TPU v4 tensor supercomputer case.

steps.title: 脈動矩陣與張量核：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Systolic matrices and TensorCores: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對v4 MXU張量shape提出可反駁的脈動矩陣與張量核模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable systolic matrices and tensorcores model and evidence record for v4 mxu tensor shapes.
steps.instruction: 在「Google TPU v4 張量超級電腦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識v4 MXU張量shape。資料與乘積沿矩陣陣列傳播；填充不足與不匹配shape可降低有效利用。 建立脈動矩陣與張量核的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是矩陣陣列與可重組三維互連。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較完整與不足批次的有效算術佔比。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify v4 mxu tensor shapes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Google TPU v4 tensor supercomputer. Operands/products traverse matrix arrays; underfilling and mismatched shapes reduce effective use. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of systolic matrices and tensorcores, focusing on matrix arrays and reconfigurable 3d interconnects. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare useful arithmetic fractions for full/underfilled batches. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較完整與不足批次的有效算術佔比。
steps.observationEn: Compare useful arithmetic fractions for full/underfilled batches.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：脈動陣列的峯值永遠等於每種shape實效。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Systolic peak performance equals achieved performance for every shape.
steps.check: 提交v4 MXU張量shape的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for v4 mxu tensor shapes.

knowledge.title: 脈動矩陣與張量核
knowledge.text: 資料與乘積沿矩陣陣列傳播；填充不足與不匹配shape可降低有效利用。 本課架構對應：v4 MXU張量shape
knowledge.textEn: Operands/products traverse matrix arrays; underfilling and mismatched shapes reduce effective use. Course architecture correspondence: v4 MXU tensor shapes

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較完整與不足批次的有效算術佔比。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；脈動陣列的峯值永遠等於每種shape實效。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare useful arithmetic fractions for full/underfilled batches. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Systolic peak performance equals achieved performance for every shape.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設算術強度 I=3 FLOP/byte、頻寬 B=0.9 TB/s、計算峯值 39 TFLOP/s，理想 roofline=min(39,I×B)=2.7 TFLOP/s。皆非產品規格，未含同步、精度轉換或工作形狀損失。
knowledge.textEn: Assume I=3 FLOP/byte, B=0.9 TB/s and compute peak 39 TFLOP/s: ideal roofline min(39,I×B)=2.7 TFLOP/s. These are not product specifications; synchronization, precision conversion and shape inefficiency are omitted.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「Google TPU v4 張量超級電腦」的「脈動矩陣與張量核：架構分析」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「算力中心：核心不是答案」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Systolic matrices and TensorCores: architecture analysis” in “Google TPU v4 tensor supercomputer”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Compute Center: Cores Are Not the Answer” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 就v4 MXU張量shape的「脈動矩陣與張量核」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for systolic matrices and tensorcores in v4 mxu tensor shapes?
options: 資料與乘積沿矩陣陣列傳播；填充不足與不匹配shape可降低有效利用。
脈動陣列的峯值永遠等於每種shape實效。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Operands/products traverse matrix arrays; underfilling and mismatched shapes reduce effective use.
Systolic peak performance equals achieved performance for every shape.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 資料與乘積沿矩陣陣列傳播；填充不足與不匹配shape可降低有效利用。 比較完整與不足批次的有效算術佔比。
quiz.explanationEn: Operands/products traverse matrix arrays; underfilling and mismatched shapes reduce effective use. Compare useful arithmetic fractions for full/underfilled batches.

steps.title: 脈動矩陣與張量核：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Systolic matrices and TensorCores: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對v4 MXU張量shape提出可反駁的脈動矩陣與張量核模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable systolic matrices and tensorcores model and evidence record for v4 mxu tensor shapes.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「脈動矩陣與張量核」模型，檢查v4 MXU張量shape的兩個假想案例。比較完整與不足批次的有效算術佔比。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分資料與乘積沿矩陣陣列傳播；填充不足與不匹配shape可降低有效利用。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous systolic matrices and tensorcores model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving v4 mxu tensor shapes. Compare useful arithmetic fractions for full/underfilled batches. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Operands/products traverse matrix arrays; underfilling and mismatched shapes reduce effective use." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較完整與不足批次的有效算術佔比。
steps.observationEn: Compare useful arithmetic fractions for full/underfilled batches.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：脈動陣列的峯值永遠等於每種shape實效。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Systolic peak performance equals achieved performance for every shape.
steps.check: 提交v4 MXU張量shape的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for v4 mxu tensor shapes.

steps.title: 向量純量與嵌入：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Vectors, scalars and embeddings: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對vector/scalar單元提出可反駁的向量純量與嵌入模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable vectors, scalars and embeddings model and evidence record for vector/scalar units.
steps.instruction: 在「Google TPU v4 張量超級電腦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識vector/scalar單元。矩陣算子外的向量、標量與稀疏存取可能成爲瓶頸。 建立向量純量與嵌入的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是矩陣陣列與可重組三維互連。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。拆分矩陣與embedding／逐元素的時間預算。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify vector/scalar units in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Google TPU v4 tensor supercomputer. Vector, scalar and sparse work outside matrix operations can dominate. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of vectors, scalars and embeddings, focusing on matrix arrays and reconfigurable 3d interconnects. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate matrix and embedding/elementwise time budgets. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 拆分矩陣與embedding／逐元素的時間預算。
steps.observationEn: Separate matrix and embedding/elementwise time budgets.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有神經網絡算子都在矩陣單元滿速執行。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every neural operator runs at matrix-unit peak speed.
steps.check: 提交vector/scalar單元的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for vector/scalar units.
